verdict.rationale: Twenty's first-party docs say workflows can be triggered by record changes, schedules, or incoming webhooks. Workflows can chain record operations, email, HTTP requests, code, branches, iterators, delays, and AI Agent steps. AI agents are documented as executing multi-step tasks autonomously within the permission model, which covers background automation without manual intervention. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled or agent workflows run reliably unattended, and detail on run monitoring, execution logs, or limits for background runs.
